description: O-12 / O-17: a ten-conversation synthetic corpus and twenty global or aggregate questions with the expected supporting conversations and answer elements.

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: Hi, I am Ilse. I just finished a night shift as a nurse at the hospital in Utrecht.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Welcome. What do you do to unwind after a shift?

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: I volunteer at the community garden near my flat, mostly growing tomatoes and basil.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: That sounds relaxing. Any plans coming up?

turns.speaker: Ilse
turns.text: Next month I am planning a bike trip to Texel, if the weather holds.

turns.speaker: Matthias
turns.text: Ich bin Matthias und arbeite als Tischler in Köln.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Schön, dich kennenzulernen. Was machst du in deiner Freizeit?

turns.speaker: Matthias
turns.text: Ich fotografiere gern Vögel am Rhein und fahre jeden Samstag Rad.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Hast du Urlaubspläne?

turns.speaker: Matthias
turns.text: Im Sommer will ich mit dem Fahrrad nach Texel.

turns.speaker: Femke
turns.text: Ik ben Femke, ik werk als docent op een middelbare school in Zwolle.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Leuk! Wat doe je naast je werk?

turns.speaker: Femke
turns.text: Ik zing in een koor, we repeteren elke dinsdag.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: En verder?

turns.speaker: Femke
turns.text: Ik fiets veel in het weekend, en mijn kat Pluis zit dan thuis te mokken.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Heb je nog plannen voor de zomer?

turns.speaker: Femke
turns.text: In juli ga ik vier dagen naar Drenthe.

turns.speaker: Inés
turns.text: Hola, soy Inés. Trabajo como enfermera en un centro de salud en Valencia.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Encantado. ¿Qué haces los fines de semana?

turns.speaker: Inés
turns.text: Los sábados hago cerámica en un taller, y también cuido un pequeño huerto.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: ¿Tienes mascotas?

turns.speaker: Inés
turns.text: Sí, un perro que se llama Canelo.

turns.speaker: Tomasz
turns.text: I am Tomasz. I work as a carpenter in a small workshop in Gdansk.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Nice. What fills your evenings?

turns.speaker: Tomasz
turns.text: Every Thursday I play chess at a club near the old town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Anything you want to learn?

turns.speaker: Tomasz
turns.text: I plan to learn Dutch next year, my partner's family is from Rotterdam.

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: Noor here. I am a nurse practitioner at a clinic in Delft.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: How do you stay active?

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: I run three mornings a week along the canal.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Anything else?

turns.speaker: Noor
turns.text: I also started a book club with some neighbours, we meet once a month.

turns.speaker: Aiko
turns.text: 愛子です。京都で小学校の先生をしています。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: はじめまして。休日は何をしていますか。

turns.speaker: Aiko
turns.text: 週末は水彩画を描いています。

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: これからやりたいことはありますか。

turns.speaker: Aiko
turns.text: 来年、オランダ語を勉強するつもりです。

turns.speaker: Greta
turns.text: Ich bin Greta und arbeite als Hebamme in Kiel.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Und was machst du am Feierabend?

turns.speaker: Greta
turns.text: Ich singe in einem Chor, wir treten manchmal in Altenheimen auf.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Was steht als Nächstes an?

turns.speaker: Greta
turns.text: Im Herbst fange ich einen Niederländischkurs an.

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Ik ben Bram, loodgieter in Utrecht.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Wat doe je graag in je vrije tijd?

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Sinds kort leer ik cello spelen, en elke zondag ga ik fietsen.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Heb je huisdieren?

turns.speaker: Bram
turns.text: Twee konijnen, Appel en Peer.

turns.speaker: Mateus
turns.text: Sou o Mateus, engenheiro de software em Lisboa.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Prazer. O que fazes à noite?

turns.speaker: Mateus
turns.text: Jogo xadrez online quase todas as noites.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Tens animais?

turns.speaker: Mateus
turns.text: Não, mas gostava de ter um gato.
